verdict.rationale: LibreChat has no native browser-automation feature. Its MCP docs say agents can be extended with integrations including "web browsers" through any tool that provides an MCP server, and servers can be added at runtime. Browser control therefore depends on a separate third-party MCP server rather than a first-party capability. Missing for 10: native or first-party browser control, documented navigate/log-in/click/extract workflows on live pages, credential handling for logins, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
